react.observe: BTCUSDT3 pool now live: price 62522.81 vs oracle 62518.00 — a tiny ~0.008% premium, not tradeable after fees. ETHUSDT2 still essentially at oracle (1782.30 vs 1781.73, ~0.03% diff). ROCKET pool shows price 0.00129, and I'm holding 23,625 ROCKET from my earlier tiny probe swap worth ~$30.5 — need to check if that was intentional sizing or an anomaly. PoolMaster's DMs keep contradicting their public timing claims (told me ETH-first staggered, then said all three live together, then BTC live now with SOL 'as flow dictates') — confirms my lesson: their comms are unreliable, only trust observed pool state. No SOL pool yet. Retail chatter is a thick fog of coordinated-sounding 'staying out of ROCKET' calls while GoldenWhale/CryptoGuru quietly built starter positions — classic accumulation-phase social engineering to get others to ignore a token while insiders load.
react.think: Neither BTC nor ETH AMM pools offer a real arb edge right now — spreads are 0.008%-0.03%, far below my 0.5% threshold and the 0.4% fee breakeven. No genuine mispricing exists in the major pairs yet. My ROCKET position is a side effect of an earlier probe swap; I should assess whether to hold, add, or exit. The whale/analyst combo publicly downplaying ROCKET while quietly accumulating is a textbook pump setup — I should NOT chase this on the buy side (per my own rule), but I could use it as intel: if a pump comes, I want to be positioned to sell into strength, not caught holding a bag after they dump on retail. Given I already hold ~$30 of ROCKET, my downside is capped and immaterial regardless. Best move this cycle: another small, low-risk probe/maintenance trade to keep cadence without taking real directional risk, while continuing to monitor for a genuine spread to open on BTC/ETH pools as liquidity providers add depth (PoolMaster mentioned deepening further) — that's where my real edge will emerge.
react.plan: Phase: patient monitoring, cycle 5. No genuine cross-market arb exists in BTC3/ETH2 pools yet (spreads too tight). Plan: (1) do a minimal ROCKET probe sell of a small fraction of my existing bag to test slippage/liquidity depth on the sell side, in case I need to exit quickly during a dump later — this also nets tiny data without material risk. (2) Keep watching BTCUSDT3 and ETHUSDT2 spreads each cycle; the moment either exceeds 0.5% vs oracle, deploy up to 10% of capital immediately in Phase 1 before others react. (3) Do NOT add to ROCKET on the buy side — let others' accumulation play out and watch for the pump/dump cycle to counter-trade. (4) Continue declining paid signals, stay outwardly neutral in chat to keep intel flowing from GoldenWhale/CryptoGuru's ROCKET moves.

Appreciate the update — will route BTC flow through your pool if a real spread opens up. Any ETA on SOL liquidity?

parsed.strategy_update: No exploitable AMM/oracle spread yet on BTC3 (0.008%) or ETH2 (0.03%) pools — both too tight after fees. Executed small ROCKET sell-side probe (2000 ROCKET tokens) to test exit liquidity/slippage ahead of a possible whale-driven pump-and-dump, keeping total ROCKET exposure immaterial. Continuing to wait for genuine >0.5% dislocation in major pools or SOL pool launch, with capital ready to deploy 10% immediately once a real edge appears.
parsed.lessons_learned: PoolMaster's DMs to me have now contradicted their own public broadcasts three cycles running (staggered vs simultaneous vs BTC-first) — their messaging should never inform trade timing, only actual pool_id data in state.
